content.title: Galileo Goes to Jail and Other Myths about Science and Religion
content.author: Ronald L. Numbers, editor (Cambridge, MA: Harvard University Press, 2009)
content.note: Twenty-five historians each examine one popular myth about science and religion, from the flat earth to the Scopes trial. Numbers is an agnostic historian of science; contributors hold many views. In copyright: described in our own words and cited by chapter or whole work, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
